mapper.select: SELECT * FROM diet_records WHERE id = #{recordId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_records SET food_option_id = #{record.foodOptionId}, food_name_snapshot = #{record.foodNameSnapshot}, category_snapshot = #{record.categorySnapshot}, tags_snapshot_json = #{record.tagsSnapshotJson, typeHandler=com.hyf.agent_work_foot.food.mapper.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, actual_price = #{record.actualPrice}, meal_type = #{record.mealType}, eaten_at = #{record.eatenAt}, business_date = #{record.businessDate}, updated_at = #{record.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{record.id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE diet_records SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{recordId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_price), 0) AS totalSpent, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS recordedDays FROM diet_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND business_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT CASE #{groupBy} WHEN 'DAY' THEN DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') WHEN 'MONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y-%m') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(business_date, '%Y') END AS period, SUM(actual_price) AS totalSpent FROM diet_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND business_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(category_snapshot, ''), '未分类') AS category, SUM(actual_price) AS totalSpent, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM diet_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND business_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(category_snapshot, ''), '未分类') ORDER BY recordCount DESC, category ASC
